testcase.name: canonical in-root paths are authorized with scoped operations
traversal, absolute, mixed-separator, alias, and platform-ambiguous paths are denied
existing symlink or junction components are denied by no-follow policy
linked resource roots and non-directory traversal are denied
egress uses exact canonical origins and defaults to denial
allowlist and sandbox contracts reject inconsistent or unsupported policy
policy and request Proxies, accessors, and serialized lookalikes fail without execution
resource root identity is revalidated after policy issue
egress rejects fragments and requires each redirect hop to be reauthorized
opaque secret handles expose no serializable identifier or secret material
secret handle construction rejects material-bearing and executable inputs
handles are denied at every prohibited outbound boundary
raw secret-shaped fields and values fail closed
payload inspection rejects accessors, Proxies, cycles, and non-JSON values without execution
ordinary egress cannot carry handles or secret-shaped payloads
last-mile secret use requires both policy and handle destination bindings
foreign boundaries cannot mint handles, policies, or decisions accepted here
secret handles reject cleartext HTTP destination bindings
